text:
jules.pm: Hey team — starting today! Quick setup asks: Figma (Redwood org + "Redwood UI" library), access to Product Roadmap Notion, and the research Drive folder. Who handles invites? Also any "must-do" items for a product/designer in week 1?

marta.designops: welcome @jules :tada: I can add you to Figma and the design Google group. Use jules@redwood.com? I'll also trigger Notion invite once you submit the access form (link in #devex).

jules.pm: yes jules@redwood.com. Also could I get added to the Checkout Revamp board and the team's Slack channel?

marta.designops: will add you to product-checkout and the Figma file permissions. For the board — which one, the Miro for flow mapping or the Figma board?

jeve.design: welcome @jules! Quick tips:
- Design crits Tue 10am; bring one flow/mock next week if possible.
- Enable 'Redwood UI' via Assets > Libraries; file named "Redwood UI — v2".
- Read the 'Design Decisions: Checkout' doc in Notion under Product > Decisions.

jules.pm: thanks Eve. Where's the roadmap doc? I couldn't find Product > Roadmap > Q2 earlier.

omar.research: hi @jules, I'm research ops. I'll add you to the Research Drive and the participant tracker. We use the Notion "Research Plan" template — duplicate it when you start. If you want to observe a session this week, I can schedule an internal one.

jules.pm: that would be great — would love to shadow. Also do we have staging access for prototype testing?

infra-bot: To request staging environment access, please open an issue in #eng-requests with subject `access: staging`. Include your email and the feature or repo.

marta.designops: I'll follow up in #eng-requests and ping infra to speed it up.

jeve.design: small checklist I recommend for week 1:
- Accept Figma/Google/Notion invites
- Enable Redwood UI Figma library
- Join Tue crit + weekly sync
- Read recent Checkout decisions + Q2 roadmap highlights
- Shadow 1 research session
- File staging access ticket in #eng-requests

jules.pm: super helpful — copying checklist now. One question on research: are external participants reimbursed?

omar.research: yes, default stipend is $15 per participant unless UX wants a different amount. For internal testing tag the plan as `internal` and list participants in the internal sheet.

marta.designops: I've sent the Figma invite and added you to design-team Google group. You should see Notion invite after the product access request.

jeve.design: also FYI, prototypes live in the 'Checkout Prototypes' Figma file; you can request edit access there if needed.

jules.pm: I see the invites, thanks everyone! If I hit permission errors I'll ping @marta.designops. Looking forward to joining the revamp squad :rocket:
